sources.title: Compatibility of iZotope Products on macOS
sources.note: Apple silicon native/Rosetta formats with minimum versions; per-macOS minimum versions (macOS 26 list updated 2025-12-19, macOS 15 list updated 2026-08-25, macOS 13/14 lists 2024-05-16). iZotope VST2 plug-ins run only under Rosetta.

sources.title: Compatibility of iZotope Products on Windows
sources.note: "All current iZotope products work without any specific issues" on Windows 11.

sources.title: Virtual Instruments - Compatibility
sources.note: Win 10+ (64-bit), ARM processors not supported on Windows; Mac OS 11+; Standalone, VST, AAX, Audio Unit, NKS; tested on the latest Ableton Live, Bitwig, Cubase, FL Studio, Logic Pro, Pro Tools, Studio One, Reaper and others.

sources.title: Virtual Effects - Compatibility
sources.note: Win 11+ (64-bit), ARM not supported on Windows; Mac OS 11+; VST, AAX, Audio Unit, NKS.

sources.title: Compatibility - macOS Tahoe
sources.note: Updated 2026-02-26: compatibility of all Arturia products validated on macOS Tahoe (legacy products excluded).

sources.title: Compatibility - macOS Sequoia
sources.note: Updated 2025-05-20: all Arturia products validated on macOS Sequoia.

sources.title: Compatibility with Apple Silicon M1 processors and above
sources.note: Since V Collection 8.2 and FX Collection 2.1, Arturia software runs natively on Apple Silicon as Universal Binaries.

sources.title: Plugin Alliance - System Requirements
sources.note: Mac: Intel or Apple Silicon, macOS 13 - macOS 26; Windows 11 down to Windows 10; most plug-ins support AAX Native, VST2.4, VST3 and AU.

sources.title: macOS 26 Tahoe Compatibility Statement
sources.note: All Plugin Alliance software products tested successfully and supported on macOS 26 Tahoe (info updated 2025-12-02).

sources.title: Plugin Alliance product catalogue (Shopify products.json)
sources.note: Used only to confirm product names and handles.

sources.title: System Requirements
sources.note: macOS 10.15 or later, Intel or Apple Silicon, AU/VST2/VST3/AAX; Windows 10 or 11, VST2/VST3/AAX.

sources.title: Supported Operating Systems
sources.note: Full support: macOS 10.15+ and Windows 11; unofficial (untested) support: macOS 10.13/10.14 and Windows 10.

sources.title: Supported Digital Audio Workstations
sources.note: Fully supported & tested: Ableton Live 11+, Cubase 11+, FL Studio 20, Logic Pro (not 10.7-10.7.3), Pro Tools 2021+, Reaper 6+, Studio One 6+; Windows ARM devices not supported.

sources.title: macOS Golden Gate Compatibility
sources.note: 2026-09-21: no issues identified with Slate Digital or Eiosis plug-ins so far; official Complete Access compatibility pending (SSL and Harrison still validating).

sources.title: What are the system requirements for XLN Audio products?
sources.note: macOS 10.13 or later (supports Tahoe, Sequoia, Sonoma, Ventura, Monterey back to High Sierra), Intel and Apple Silicon (M5 and older); Windows 10, 11 64-bit; formats VST3, VST, AU, AAX, standalone (DB-30 has no VST2).

sources.title: Plug-in Compatibility
sources.note: Tested formats VST3, AU, AAX; hosts Pro Tools, Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, FL Studio; Apple Silicon M1-M4 and Windows (Intel and ARM); macOS 26, 15, 14 (13 to 10.15 not actively tested); Windows 11 (10 not actively tested).

sources.title: SSL 360, 360-enabled plug-ins, UF8/UF1/UC1 and macOS 27 (Golden Gate)
sources.note: 2026-09-28: macOS 27 not yet tested and currently unsupported; public beta AU builds offered as a stop-gap (4K G 1.4.1, 4K E 1.8.1, 4K B 1.11.1, Channel Strip 2 2.11.1, Bus Compressor 2 1.10.1, 360 Link 1.5.1, Meter 1.7.1, Meter Pro 1.4.1, Harrison 32 Classic 2.1.2).
